description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDependentDao class, which provides data access methods for employee dependents in the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching dependents, utilizing Doctrine ORM features.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling employee dependents, providing methods for CRUD operations and searching dependents within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of dependents for a specific employee identified by employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Fetches a specific dependent record for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingDependentIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves existing dependent sequence IDs for a given employee and list of IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee dependent, assigning sequence numbers if necessary, with validation.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes specified dependents for a given employee ID.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs a search for employee dependents based on filter parameters with pagination support.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for dependents search results.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching the search filter parameters.
